The noble family in question must be written on the card when the ability is acquired, and the family's head must countersign the ability. Such a retainer gains +1 level of resistance to domination effects not cast by a member of the family, but looses 1 level of resistance to ALL effects cast by a member of the family. Benign supernatural effects cast by a family member, if the family is ' Of the Blood' either have their duration increased by 50% or if the effect is numeric, grant a 50% increase in effect. In addition, if on adventure with a member of the family who possesses an immunity to a particular type of informational spell/miracle/neuronics or evocation, or other informational effects, then the Retainer is also so protected. Should the Retainer leave a family member behind on an adventure, and was not instructed to leave the adventure by a family member, the retainer suffers a permanent loss of 2pts of Dexterity Armour Class until forgiven by the abandoned Noble. Should a Family member leave a retainer behind on an adventure, and were not instructed to leave by another (senior) family member, then the family member suffers the loss of DAC as detailed above until forgiven by the retainer.

May be used 3 times per day only, each use granting immunity to the specific effect for 5 minutes and must be declared within 2 seconds of suffering the effect.
